mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM punch_exemption_assignment assignment WHERE assignment.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND assignment.source = 'STANDING_LIST' AND assignment.valid_to IS NULL ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM auth_principal principal JOIN auth_principal_role_assignment assignment ON assignment.principal_id = principal.principal_id JOIN auth_role role ON role.role_id = assignment.role_id AND role.role_code = 'EXECUTIVE' WHERE principal.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND (assignment.valid_to IS NULL OR assignment.valid_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END
SELECT employee_number FROM employee_version WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND effective_to IS NULL ORDER BY effective_from DESC, employee_version_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO punch_exemption_assignment ( exemption_id, employee_id, listed_employee_number, source, valid_from, valid_to ) SELECT #{exemptionId}, #{employeeId}, #{employeeNumber}, 'STANDING_LIST', #{validFrom}, NULL FROM employee employee WHERE employee.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM punch_exemption_assignment assignment WHERE assignment.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND assignment.source = 'STANDING_LIST' AND assignment.valid_to IS NULL )
